# EX58-SOURCE-2026-10-11 — Complete Director-side verdict

**The 58-question source-authoring conference is complete.** All **26 FL, 12 SO, 14 TR and six RP-A questions** now have concrete decisions, source mappings and operating procedures. The complete expedition/transport/social/reputation candidate can now be authored for separate exact review. **No additional generic preliminary conference is required.**

The unavailable draft was reconstructed from the intact frozen submission. The completed verdict, register, profiles, examples and evidence are now saved.

## Controlling decisions

### Expedition clock, work and provisions

The verdict retains the **12-character Expedition cap** and establishes one elapsed-time history for participants, work, travel, rests, resource consumption and scheduled events. A team assignment does not grant additional labor, duplicate assistance or an overlapping beneficial rest.

Travel’s **480-minute nominal tranche** is distinguished from its route- and pace-adjusted elapsed duration. Crafting, training, research, treatment and other explicitly timed procedures retain their actual required work. Completed Strain, Rest Debt, healing and class-resource rules remain controlling rather than being replaced by older Loop summaries.

**NEW Supply authoring** defines a physical procurement basket: two pounds of ration-equivalent food, eight pints of potable water, one pint of lamp oil in its flask, and a quarter-pound of ordinary camp sundries. At the selected low-tier source prices, the refill reference is **63 cp and 11.25 lb**, excluding drinking-water containers. Two new waterskins bring the initial portable reference to **103 cp and 13.25 lb**.

That basket is **not a requirement to burn unused oil or discard sound stock every day**. Actual food, water, lighting and procedural expenditures have separate, nonduplicating records. Forage, camps, purchases and magical support cannot manufacture stock merely by awarding an abstract Supply label.

### Pressure, complications, extraction and retreat

Pressure now has a single cause and event history. Splitting teams, changing the record ID or returning through the same checkpoint does not reset that history or create another reward.

The register supplies a complete complication-severity rule, bounded secondary extraction scheduling, finite route checkpoints, participant-budget arithmetic and a retreat procedure. It also resolves the partial-Watch exit boundary: exposure due before reaching safety is settled once, without later inventing a patrol against a party already inside Haven.

These are bounded authoring choices, not claims that an actual route is mapped, a camp is safe or a particular enemy encounter is balanced.

### All transport options

**Every one of the 29 original transport rows is covered:** nine mounts, fourteen tack/drawn-vehicle/service entries and six waterborne entries. The catalogue preserves the actual source prices, speeds, carrying figures and missing/null fields. Added creature statistics, body dimensions, crew requirements, capacities, handling, damage, repair and service procedures are explicitly **NEW**.

Mounts, class companions, crafted devices and vehicles remain separate rules objects. For ordinary controlled mounts, the chosen procedure gives the mount **one complete turn immediately after the rider’s complete turn**, rather than permitting interleaved movement or an extra attack sequence.

The class-interface register also identifies the narrow **NEW interpretation of Dragoon’s separate twenty-foot-before-Weave clause**: voluntary self-propelled movement qualifies; merely being carried does not. Its original wording and distinct fifteen-foot Momentum procedure remain preserved. Pending Cavalry/Mounted Combatant comparisons receive no approval through this decision.

### Reputation and the Cult Escapee conflict

**Adopt the NEW −3 through +3 standing policy with five descriptive bands**, without an automatic standing or alignment modifier to d20 rolls. The competing eleven-band source and Player-modifier source remain preserved, with their differences explicitly recorded.

The Cult Escapee discrepancy is resolved as follows:

**For fresh initialization, the complete background feature controls: the applicable suspicious religious authority starts Disliked/−1, not the runtime map’s +1.**

An existing save is **not** reset to −1. Where the source version and history establish an erroneous initial contribution, the correction replaces that initialization and then replays the actual earned events. For example, an erroneous +1 start followed by an earned +1 becomes **−1 + 1 = 0**, rather than deleting the earned change.

Unknown keys, unrecognized versions, absence, null, raw values and history remain intact. No real saves were accessed or migrated. The package retains all **20 background bindings, 44 faction definitions and twelve supplied preservation probes**.

### Ordinary social scenes and faction turns

**Meeting the declared social DC earns the declared successful result.** A costly agreement is a separately declared, optional branch, not an undisclosed extra charge imposed after a successful roll.

The verdict completes ordinary scene timing, outside-initiative Help, unchanged-premise retries, communication requirements, witnesses and standing-event accounting. Social checks do not confer magical control, legal authority, universal truth or consent.

The **NEW twenty-four-hour faction checkpoint** reports actual faction work and coalesces with a genuine return checkpoint. It does not generate free labor, research, fortification or attacks. Rival clocks have finite triggers, duplicate-event protection and prerequisite checks; crossing a threshold does not teleport an actor or manufacture a claim.

### Haven settlement and the next descent

The verdict separates physical intake, provenance, appraisal, a real buyer’s offer, tax, mandatory expenses, sponsor shares, insurance and distribution. Purchases, sales and percentage obligations use explicit copper rounding without counting the same charge twice.

The complete worked sequence follows an objective through descent, encounter, retreat, cargo handling, extraction, Haven intake, settlement, rest and next-descent procurement.

Its synthetic settlement example distinguishes:

| Stage | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Gross sale | 120 gp |
| Tax | 6 gp |
| Mandatory inspection | 2 gp |
| Guild share on the defined net basis | 22.40 gp |
| Sale proceeds after those deductions | **89.60 gp** |
| Other actual expedition expenses | 20.20 gp |
| Operating profit | **69.40 gp** |

The example then preserves capital and the next-expedition reserve before distribution. Its clocks, lamp-refuelling pauses, custody, cargo limits and Rest Debt are chronological records, not merely a final financial total.

## What was checked

The final standard-library validator was run and reproduced with **2,316 passing checks and zero failures**. These include source preservation, original-question equality, actual book passages and transport rows, source-reference paths, full verdict/register wording parity and bounded reference arithmetic.

Within that total are **92 named numerical calculations, 420 complication-severity trials, 28 checkpoint trials and 175 standing invariant trials**. A separate comparison verified that **all 304 extracted source payloads remain unchanged**. Preservation of all **194 earlier V2 payloads** is also covered.

All seventeen class datasets were parsed, covering **1,223 records**, and **94 complete selected class comparisons** are retained. That is not a new balance review of unrelated class cards.

The qualitative worked sequences and proposal dispositions are **authored expectations**. They are not full expedition, vehicle, faction or class-runtime passes; nor do they authenticate campaign premises or demonstrate human teaching and balance. The executable validator and complete reports are included in the package.

## Next gate and remaining boundaries

**There is no remaining generic source question blocking authorship of the complete candidate.** The next submission should contain the actual complete player and Director chapters, all profiles, both full data envelopes, preserved source layers, worked records and the finite validation evidence specified in the acceptance contract.

Particular operations still need their real prerequisites: actual geography and hazards, providers and available stock, source-version evidence for ambiguous imported standing, exceptional artifact valuation inputs, and operative rules for specialist spatial transport. Those are not permissions supplied by a price, name or successful check, and they do not reopen this source conference.

The fulfilled **LAX, NWX, LRX, TEX and 687 internal/433 public recipe scopes carry forward**. Ordinary authored spells remain **412 reviewed/436 pending**. This verdict grants **zero exact-card, class, feat or spell promotions**.

DD-01, remaining catalogs, full integration, companion runtime, human teaching/balance and final whole-game flow remain open. The delivery sequence is unchanged:

**Actual final joint Codex/GPT whole-game flow agreement → already-authorized GitHub push → verified remote commit → careful cosmology review.**
